entries.name: Inclusive Language Model
entries.definition: The governed inclusive evidence-understanding layer. DataNest currently has partial ILM-1 orchestration foundations rather than a proprietary foundation-model claim.

entries.name: Amalgamated Learning Language
entries.definition: Target-state language-evolution layer that learns reviewed articulation patterns without overwriting source evidence.

entries.name: Collective Source Language
entries.definition: Target-state versioned collective semantic representation that retains scope, provenance, uncertainty, supporting evidence, contrary evidence, and supersession history.

entries.name: Group Aligned Learning
entries.definition: Target-state method for building governed collective understanding within an authorized group or scope.

entries.name: Group Aligned Learning User-Experience
entries.definition: Target-state adaptive presentation layer that changes articulation for comprehension without changing underlying evidence, authority, or uncertainty.

entries.name: Resonance Allowance Tolerance Boundaries
entries.definition: Target-state user-declared collaboration boundaries distinguishing allowance, tolerance, and hard non-negotiables.

entries.name: Resonance Sovereign Governance Protocol
entries.definition: The approved constitutional governance model for Resonance DataNest, extending existing sovereign-governance and authority-execution foundations.

entries.name: Project Director
entries.definition: Target-state governed AI orchestration representative for project lifecycle, UNIFI decomposition, TranScheduler conduct, evidence monitoring, and escalation within an explicit mandate.

entries.name: Conversation Specialist
entries.definition: Target-state governed relationship-intelligence and communication layer for approved internal and external conversation channels.

entries.name: Growth Spark
entries.definition: Target-state opportunity-sensing capability that converts eligible relationship signals into evidence-backed growth candidates; it is distinct from iBank Sparks.

entries.name: Barterer Tender
entries.definition: Target-state iBank AI Representative for governed barter, tender, value-comparison, proposal, and bounded negotiation workflows.

entries.name: N0nymous Squad
entries.definition: Pseudonymous evidence-based participation and capability consideration layer. Current implementation is partial and does not itself grant project, legal, financial, or governance authority.

entries.name: Resonance iBank
entries.definition: Target-state governed value, resource, and exchange layer. The future External Value Rail is separate from the current Sparks internal-utility rail and requires separate implementation and legal/governance gates.

entries.name: Sparks
entries.definition: Implemented DataNest internal utility for earned contribution utility and approved project services; current Sparks have no cash value and do not create ownership, voting, or financial authority.
